A small fix update to Spectra 1.0. Install it over 1.0.0; your data stays.

**[Download Spectra.apk](https://github.com/m0n0t0ne0ne/spectra/releases/download/v1.0.1/Spectra.apk)**

### Fixes
- **Insights: days before your first weigh-in now count.** Calories burned need a weight, so days logged before your first weigh-in were shown as blank in the Daily balance chart. They now use your nearest weigh-in.
- **Log your weight for any past day.** Targets → Weight now has a date next to the weight box. Pick a day to log or correct that day's weight.
- **Weights keep their decimal** (151.2 lb no longer shows as 151 lb).
